maya: Launching solace13b (int4) on canary fleet — seeing intermittent soft OOMs under bursty tail traffic.
maya: Canary profile in use: {"batching":{"enabled":true,"batch_size":4,"max_latency_ms":40},"generation":{"max_new_tokens":512,"temperature":0.7},"prefetch":true}
maya: Error excerpt from pod logs:
maya: ```
[oom] gpu_alloc failed: tried to alloc 128MB, free 60MB, fragmentation_highwater=0.79
kv_cache_grow: from 10MB to 24MB
```
maya: Repro: 25 concurrent clients, avg prompt ~180 tokens, bursts push many >450 tokens. One pod peaked at ~560MB and OOMed. :frowning_face:
jordan: Ack. Pattern looks like per-request KV growth combined with allocator fragmentation. Can you share the mem-trace output?
maya: Dropped a quick mem-trace run (single pod) during a synthetic burst. Peak alloc list: [305, 412, 388, 560, 372]
ashley: Short-term mitigations to push asap: set batch_size -> 1, max_new_tokens -> 128, and disable prefetch for the model. Also set kv_prune_threshold=0.55 so caches trim earlier. Tradeoff: slightly worse perf for long contexts.
rik: +1. Prefetch is great for steady-state but hurts when lots of concurrent warmups. Also add a runtime guard: if free_gpu_mem < 250MB reject new generation requests with 503 (circuit) to avoid hard OOMs.
luis: For root cause diag: enable --mem-trace=per-request and collect allocator histograms and free/used buckets. Also try flipping int4 fused kernels off on one node to see allocator behaviour. Might be kernel allocator fragmentation on current driver.
ci-bot: starting stress job: stress-gen --concurrency 30 --duration 60s --len-dist=long-tail; results will publish to /tmp/solace-canary.
maya: mem-trace CSV attached in thread (summary above). Spikes align with kv_cache_grow events. Looks like bursts cause many requests to expand KV at similar times -> transient peak.
ashley: Ok. Implementing temp profile change in catalog: {"batch_size":1,"max_new_tokens":128,"prefetch":false,"kv_prune_threshold":0.55} and deploy as 10% canary. Also add fallback policy to solace13b-lite on OOM.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy triggered: solace13b-int4 profile updated -> traffic=10%. Monitoring eng-ml/model-oom alerts.
maya: Rolling change now. Will watch metrics and logs for 30m.
rik: If 10% is clean, promote to 50% then 100% with a scheduled rollback window. Also file a kernel/driver validation ticket to test allocator behaviour across CUDA versions.
luis: Schedule a 1hr failure-mode sesh: run stress at 70% load with int4 kernels disabled vs enabled and capture fragmentation metrics.
maya: Quick update after 25m: 10% canary had 0 new OOMs. One latency tail (~1.2s) on a long request, but SLOs OK. Starting 50% promotion in 10m.
ashley: Great. Follow-up action items: 1) add a long-tail churn integration test to model onboarding CI, 2) include recommended profile knobs in onboarding docs, 3) triage kernel fragmentation with infra/driver.
rik: I'll add the CI test template (stress-gen harness + mem-trace assertion) to eng-ml/ci-tests repo.
maya: I'll attach a short runbook + the mem-trace CSV to PR #4821 (model onboarding). Thanks all :raised_hands:
